svg.title: Voltstream: how a problem reaches someone
svg.desc: Alerting path. Prometheus scrapes every 15 seconds from three kinds of source: the services' own metrics on port 8001, a Pushgateway that the short-lived batch containers push to as they exit, and sql-exporter, which turns two Postgres queries into gauges. Five rules: LowRenewableContribution and HighRejectRate from the speed layer's metrics, MeterDataStale and BatchSLAMiss from sql-exporter, and LambdaDivergenceHigh from the reconciliation gauge. Alertmanager routes critical and warning alerts to two receivers, and suppresses LowRenewableContribution while MeterDataStale fires for the same zone. Both receivers post to the API's webhook, which writes one log line per alert. No email, chat or pager receiver is configured. Grafana reads Prometheus and Postgres for its dashboards but plays no part in alerting.
svg.text: config/prometheus/alert_rules.yml and config/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml. F1–F6 and T are from diagram 4; (14) is the step in diagram 2.
